title: Time2pack
cardSummary: An all-in-one travel companion for planning trips, building packing lists, and keeping every travel detail in one place.
sub: An all-in-one travel companion that helps people plan trips, build packing lists, and keep every travel detail in one place.

sections.heading: Challenge
paragraphs: Travelers juggle multiple apps, notes and spreadsheets to prepare for a trip. Packing lists go stale, documents scatter across services, and flight information is hard to track in one place. The challenge was combining these workflows into one lightweight, accessible, enjoyable product.

sections.heading: Solution
paragraphs: The app brings together the core travel scenarios in a single flow:
list: Notes, photos, and offline access to trip information

sections.heading: Design Approach
paragraphs: Information is grouped around the trip itself, keeping navigation intuitive and cognitive load low. Particular attention went to:
list: Fast onboarding with no mandatory registration
Offline access for reliability while traveling

result: Time2Pack grew into a travel companion used by tens of thousands of people worldwide, with regular updates that keep improving how they plan and pack.
